character_decisions.identity: Inaria, age 20, Taiwanese/Asian adult woman with a recognizable oval-to-soft-heart face, stable major facial structure and core facial proportions, blue eyes, dark blue-black hair, and intended natural body proportions.
character_decisions.presentation: Active adult age presentation with natural translucent skin, restrained makeup, believable facial texture, and a calm, quietly confident expression.
character_decisions.hair: Shoulder-length dark blue-black hair with a soft side part and loose face-framing strands; variation from the standard portrait while preserving the hair color and recognizable hairline.
character_decisions.clothing: Refined indigo-blue wrap blouse with subtle traditional East Asian collar detailing, high-waisted charcoal wide-leg trousers, slim belt, and understated dark flats. Clothing should fit naturally without changing body proportions.
character_decisions.scene: Dreamy glasshouse conservatory at late afternoon, with softly diffused foliage and pale architectural frames in the background. Keep the environment secondary to the face and figure.
character_decisions.pose: Three-quarter standing pose with weight naturally distributed on the rear leg, front foot angled slightly outward, torso relaxed, one arm resting loosely at the side, and the other hand lightly holding a narrow book at waist height.
character_decisions.camera: Eye-level 50mm equivalent camera, vertical three-quarter full-body composition, moderate background separation, face unobstructed and large enough for identity review.
character_decisions.lighting: Soft directional daylight from camera-left with delicate shadow transition, subtle cool fill, and no harsh facial retouching or plastic sheen.

locked_constraints: Preserve Inaria age-20 identity and active adult presentation.
Preserve recognizable face shape, major facial structure, core facial proportions, blue eyes, dark blue-black hair, and intended body proportions.
Do not introduce wrong face, apparent minor age, altered ethnicity, different hair color, exaggerated makeup, plastic skin, or excessive smoothing.
Maintain plausible anatomy, natural balance, correct joint placement, and consistent limb proportions.
If hands are visible, show a clear plausible five-finger configuration with no extra, missing, fused, duplicated, or hidden-conflicting digits.
Keep both feet fully contained by the shoes with no visible malformed toes; avoid anatomy-obscuring cropping or impossible foot placement.
Keep the face unobstructed by hair, book, hands, glare, or foreground objects.
Use clean detail and a romantic, refined, dreamy Japanese-inspired visual language without decorative elements that compete with identity.
intentional_variations: Shoulder-length side-parted hairstyle instead of the standard portrait hairstyle.
Indigo wrap blouse and charcoal wide-leg trousers instead of portrait-oriented clothing.
Glasshouse conservatory setting instead of a neutral portrait background.
Natural three-quarter standing pose with a book instead of a head-and-shoulders pose.
Eye-level 50mm three-quarter full-body framing instead of a close portrait camera.
Quietly confident expression with restrained warmth instead of a neutral standard-portrait expression.
Soft late-afternoon directional lighting with cool fill instead of flat studio lighting.

notes.production_priority: Identity and body proportions take priority over clothing, scene, pose, camera, lighting, and decorative detail.
notes.anatomy_qc: Before approval, inspect hands, wrists, elbows, knees, ankles, shoe contact, weight distribution, and silhouette for plausible structure and balance.
notes.identity_qc: Compare face shape, eye placement, nose and mouth structure, jawline, hair color, and apparent age against the age-20 standard portrait reference.
notes.repair_policy: Any repair to face, hair, anatomy, pose, clothing, or camera framing requires a complete identity and anatomy recheck.
notes.reject_conditions: Reject for identity drift, wrong face or age, blue-black hair shifting to another color, malformed anatomy, unstable proportions, fused or duplicated digits, severe deformation, plastic skin, or excessive smoothing.
notes.dataset_role: This image provides useful diversity in outfit, hairstyle, conservatory setting, standing pose, full-body framing, and soft directional lighting while retaining strong identity evidence.
